educationalGoal: Learn programming and make software with Python language. Students will learn Python's grammer, data structure, control flow, and functions.
advice: In this course, students will learn basic Python programming to prepare for reading or writing AI applications. Specifically, students will learn variables, functions, control flows, data structures, input / output processing which are the basic elements of programming. Given a processing overview, the goal is for students to be able to organize the inputs, processing, and output and implement them in the Python language.
requiredKnowledge: The prerequisite skills for this course are to be able to perform basic computer operations such as keyboard operations, mouse operations, and window operations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain how to create and execute Python programs.
Be able to understand the basic data types and control flows of the Python language.
Be able to define simple functions and explain the processing, inputs and outputs of functions.
Be able to check the Python language specifications and API specifications from the references.
Be able to read programs written by others and explain inputs, processes, and outputs.
